verdict.rationale: Proa's own docs say hydrated islands emit only a small vanilla-JS module plus seed state on a shared runtime of about 1.3 KB gzipped. Components can ship CSS-only with no JavaScript, and charts render as pure server-side SVG, which together give a very small, dependency-light client footprint. missing for 10: explicit documentation of client-side dependency counts or supply-chain posture, and independent or hands-on measurement of real bundle sizes.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship a small, dependency-light client bundle to minimize runtime footprint and reduce supply-chain risk

citations.quote: Each hydrated RSJS island emits a small vanilla-JS module plus seed state, served with a shared runtime around 1.3 KB gzipped.
with a CSS-only build that ships no JavaScript at all.
Area, bar, line, donut, and stacked series drawn as pure SVG on the server.
Proa emits the server-rendered HTML plus the JavaScript required for that island
